Viktor|mid.identity: Magic damage control mage who evolves his abilities. He gains Hextech fragments by killing enemies; every 100 fragments, he permanently upgrades an ability (passive Glorious Evolution). Siphon Power (Q) hits a target, shields him and empowers his next attack; Gravity Field (W) slows, then stuns those who stay inside; Hextech Ray (E) fires a laser in a line (which leaves an explosion once upgraded); Arcane Storm (R) creates a storm he can steer that interrupts channels.
Viktor|mid.playstyle: Zone and wave-clear mage who scales with his evolutions. He controls the lane with his laser, defends himself with W against assassins and dominates teamfights with his ultimate. He struggles against longer-range mages (Xerath, Zoe, Vel'Koz).
Viktor|mid.early_game: Poke with E (laser) and Q + empowered attack. Last hit to gather fragments and reach your first evolution (often E). Keep W for defense against engages.
Viktor|mid.level_1: Siphon Power (Q) first. Q + empowered attack to trade.
Viktor|mid.level_2: Hextech Ray (E). Your main poke and wave-clear ability: hit your opponent and the minions at the same time.
Viktor|mid.level_3: Gravity Field (W) or a second E. W is your defensive tool: place it under the assassin who engages you.
Viktor|mid.level_6: Arcane Storm: a steerable storm that deals damage over time and interrupts channels. Combo: W (stun) → R → E → Q.
power_spikes: First evolution (often E): a much stronger laser.
First completed item: wave clear and poke.
All evolutions unlocked: a dominant zone mage.
Viktor|mid.lane_plan: Control the wave with E, poke and last hit for fragments. Keep W against engages. Push, then join objectives. The mid role quest (faster recall) helps you reset after pushing.
Viktor|mid.trading: Short trade: Q → empowered attack → back off. Long trade: E → Q → attack. All-in: W → R → E → Q. Give up on it against mages who poke you from out of range (Xerath).
threats: Xerath, Zoe and Vel'Koz, who outrange you.
Assassins while your W is on cooldown.
mistakes: Wasting W and no longer being able to defend yourself.
Missing last hits and delaying your evolutions.
Placing the storm far from enemies.

matchup_notes.Syndra: Dodge her stun and clear the wave with E.
matchup_notes.Yasuo: His Wind Wall doesn't block your laser; W against his engage.
matchup_notes.Zed: W under yourself the moment he reappears.
matchup_notes.Xerath: He pokes you from farther away: play around your jungler.

Viktor|mid.mid_game: Zone control around objectives: W and R make every fight costly for the enemy.
Viktor|mid.late_game: Zone mage: W on the enemy engage, R on the group, E to poke. Stay behind your frontline.
Viktor|mid.ahead: Take towers, dominate teamfights and roam with your jungler.
Viktor|mid.behind: Farm, unlock your evolutions and play with your team.
Viktor|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to unlock your evolutions and dominate teamfights with the zone from W and R.
Viktor|mid.final_tip: Last hit as much as possible: every kill brings your next evolution closer.
